excerpt: புரம் ஐந்து வேண்டியே தூது சென்ற புருஷோத்தமா

sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
புரம் ஐந்து வேண்டியே தூது சென்ற புருஷோத்தமா
அறம் தழைக்க அவதரித்த பரம்பொருளே
sections.translit:
puram aindhu vENdiyE thUdhu sendRa purushotthamA
aRam thazhaikka avadharittha paramporuLE
sections.en: Lord Purushothama, you went as an emissary on behalf of the Pandavas, seeking at least five villages for them as part of the settlement with the Kauravas. Supreme Lord Krishna, you incarnated to establish righteousness in the world.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
மானம் இழந்து கானம் சென்று பதிமூன்று
ஆண்டும் கழிந்தே மீண்ட பாண்டவர்க்கு
sections.translit:
mAnam izhandhu kAnam sendRu padhimUndRu
ANdum kazhindhE mINda pANdavarkku
sections.en: The Pandavas lost all their dignity, went to the forest for thirteen years, and returned to reclaim their royalty. You went as an emissary to negotiate with Duryodhana.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
கண்ணிலா வேந்தனவை கண்ணா நயமாய் நீ உரைத்த சொல்
வெந்தணலாய்ச் சினந்த இளவலுனை சிறைகொள்ள முனைகையிலே
மதியிலா பாலனென்று மாவுரு காட்டியே மனதிடை மருள் தந்த மாதவா
பதியிலா ஐவரும் விதி வசத்தால் வெல்வரென்று
sections.translit:
kaNNilA vEndhanavai kaNNA nayamAy nI uraittha sol
venthaNalAych chinandha iLavalunai siRaikoLLa munaigaiyilE
madhiyilA bAlanendRu mAvuru kAttiyE manadhidai maruL thandha mAdhavA
padhiyilA aivarum vidhi vasatthAl velvarendRu
sections.en: Krishna, you calmly entreated the blind king Dridharashtra’s court. The young prince Duryodhana would not tolerate it, became angry, and tried to imprison you. You revealed your true form in an imposing way to scare the naive child.  Despite all this, the conversation broke down. You knew all along that the five brothers would wage a victorious war. You served as an emissary in a final attempt to prevent war and seek a peaceful resolution.

notes: This song is based on an episode from the epic Mahabharata. Krishna went as an emissary on behalf of the Pandavas to negotiate for at least five villages for the brothers after their return from dwelling in a forest for 12 years and incognito for another extra year. All of the elders including King Dridhrashtra understood the value of Krishna’s words. The wicked Duryodana, however, did not want to part with an inch of land. In addition, he deviously tried to imprison Krishna and put an end to the negotiations. Realizing that wisdom is beyond the evil mind, Krishna showed his true form, or viswaroopam. Duryodana did not care for the divinity of Krishna, believing it to be a pretense. This paved the way for the Kurukshetra war. For details, see: Krishna’s peace negotiations fail leading to war The last-ditch effort by Krishna to bring about a peaceful settlement was in vain. Contrary to the guidance of elders in the assembly, Duryodhana tried to imprison Krishna hoping that the Pandavas would crumble upon hearing this news. Lord Krishna laughed and revealed his divine form. Instantly, with a radiant flame, devas appeared from His body. Brahma appeared from his forehead, Rudra from his chest, Lokapalakas from his hands, and Pandavas wearing armour appeared on his side and back. The entire scene was scary for several kings and ministers who closed their eyes. Duryodhana did not budge in his decision, so Lord Krishna left the court in his chariot. See the link below for details: V. உத்யோக பர்வம், 21. போர் முயற்சி in ஶ்ரீ மஹாபாரத ஸாரம், உரை ஆசிரியர் “அண்ணா”, ஶ்ரீராமகிருஷ்ண மடம், மயிலாப்பூர், சென்னை 600004, பக்கம் 673 – 718, key slokas 87.8-11, 88.13-14, 95.40-42, 127.25, 130.4-6, 131.2-15.
